headline: DPR Speaks Out on Concerns Over Regional Bond Default
summary: A deputy speaker of Indonesia's House of Representatives said concerns exist over regional government bond issuance, according to the report.
why: Regional government bonds are debt issued by local administrations in Indonesia, and default concerns affect perceived credit risk in the domestic bond market.
original_headline: DPR Buka Suara Soal Kekhawatiran Gagal Bayar Obligasi Daerah
